sentences.en: He was wearing black trousers and a beautiful white shirt.
sentences.zh: 他穿着黑色长裤和一件漂亮的白色衬衫。

sentences.en: A bull with short trousers has escaped accused of stealing.
sentences.zh: 一条短裤的公牛被误认为偷窃而逃走了。

sentences.en: How much are these black trousers and these red shirts?
sentences.zh: 这些黑色长裤和红色衬衫各多少钱？
